script:
# Stamps consumed date and the customer / project / installation links onto the
# serials involved in a stock entry.
#
# ERPNext often updates Serial No through direct database writes, which skip
# document hooks, so this runs from the Stock Entry side. Saving the Serial No
# triggers 'Serial No - Warranty Dates and Status', which recomputes the
# warranty and AMC dates.
#
# Material Issue is the consumption step, so only it stamps the consumed date.
# Material Transfer still carries the links, so serials moved to a site
# warehouse already know their customer before installation.

is_issue = doc.purpose == "Material Issue"
is_transfer = doc.purpose == "Material Transfer"

if is_issue or is_transfer:
    installation = doc.get("installation")
    project = doc.get("custom_projects") or doc.get("project")
    customer = None

    # Installation is the richest source - it carries both customer and project.
    if installation:
        row = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Installation", installation, ["customer", "project"], as_dict=True
        )
        if row:
            customer = row.get("customer")
            project = row.get("project") or project

    # Product Delivery covers the transfer leg, before an Installation exists.
    if not customer and doc.get("product_delivery"):
        row = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Product Delivery", doc.product_delivery, ["customer", "project"], as_dict=True
        )
        if row:
            customer = row.get("customer")
            project = row.get("project") or project

    # Last resort - derive the customer from the project itself.
    if not customer and project:
        customer = frappe.db.get_value("Project", project, "customer")

    for it in doc.items:
        serials = []

        bundle = it.get("serial_and_batch_bundle")
        if bundle:
            rows = frappe.get_all(
                "Serial and Batch Entry",
                filters={"parent": bundle},
                fields=["serial_no"]
            )
            serials = [r.serial_no for r in rows if r.serial_no]
        elif it.get("serial_no"):
            raw = it.serial_no.replace(",", "\n")
            serials = [s.strip() for s in raw.split("\n") if s.strip()]

        for sn in serials:
            if not frappe.db.exists("Serial No", sn):
                continue

            sn_doc = frappe.get_doc("Serial No", sn)
            changed = False

            # Existing values are never overwritten, so a later transfer cannot
            # reassign a serial that is already tied to a customer.
            if is_issue and not sn_doc.custom_consumed_date:
                sn_doc.custom_consumed_date = doc.posting_date
                changed = True

            if customer and not sn_doc.custom_customer:
                sn_doc.custom_customer = customer
                changed = True

            if project and not sn_doc.custom_project:
                sn_doc.custom_project = project
                changed = True

            if installation and not sn_doc.custom_installation:
                sn_doc.custom_installation = installation
                changed = True

            if changed:
                sn_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

    qty = frappe.utils.flt(row.qty)
    rate = frappe.utils.flt(row.rate)

# Replace a print format's default extra pages.
# Args: print_format, pages (JSON list of {page_no, label, image})
# Allowed for System Manager and Sales Manager only.
user = frappe.session.user
is_manager = user == "Administrator" or frappe.get_all("Has Role",
    filters={"parent": user, "parenttype": "User", "role": ["in", ["System Manager", "Sales Manager"]]},
    pluck="role", limit=1)
if not is_manager:
    frappe.throw("Only a System Manager or Sales Manager can change the default extra pages.")

pf = frappe.form_dict.get("print_format")
pages = json.loads(frappe.form_dict.get("pages") or "[]") or []
if not pf or not frappe.db.exists("Print Format", pf):
    frappe.throw("Print Format not found")

doc = frappe.get_doc("Print Format", pf)
doc.set("custom_extra_pages", [])
for p in pages:
    url = p.get("image")
    if not url or not p.get("page_no"):
        continue
    # Keep the file even if the quotation it was first attached to is deleted:
    # attach a second File record (same file on disk, no copy) to the Print Format.
    if url.startswith("/files/") or url.startswith("/private/files/"):
        keeper = {"file_url": url, "attached_to_doctype": "Print Format", "attached_to_name": pf}
        if not frappe.db.exists("File", keeper):
            src = frappe.db.get_value("File", {"file_url": url, "content_hash": ["is", "set"]},
                ["file_name", "is_private", "content_hash", "file_size"], as_dict=True)
            if src:
                k = frappe.get_doc({
                    "doctype": "File", "file_url": url, "file_name": src.file_name,
                    "is_private": src.is_private, "file_size": src.file_size, "content_hash": src.content_hash,
                    "attached_to_doctype": "Print Format", "attached_to_name": pf,
                })
                k.flags.copy_from_existing_file = True
                k.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    doc.append("custom_extra_pages", {"page_no": int(p.get("page_no")), "label": p.get("label") or "", "image": url})
doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
frappe.response["message"] = len(doc.custom_extra_pages)

name: Print Format - Auto Image Slots
script:
# Server Script: "Print Format - Auto Image Slots"
# Type: DocType Event | Reference DocType: Print Format | Event: Before Save
#
# Lets a Quotation print format register its own image slots for the
# Print Images tab, straight from its code:
#
#   {#- slot: Header Image | Wide photo for the top of the page -#}
#   {%- set PF_NAME = "My Format" -%}
#
# On save:
#   * every "slot:" comment becomes a row in this format's Image Slots table
#     (new labels are added, labels removed from the code are removed,
#     default images and hints already set on kept slots are preserved)
#   * the PF_NAME line is set to this format's own name, so a copied or
#     renamed-and-saved format reads its own images, not the original's
# Formats without any "slot:" line are left exactly as they are.

if doc.doc_type == "Quotation" and doc.html:
    html = doc.html

    # 1. keep PF_NAME in sync with this format's name
    key = 'set PF_NAME = "'
    i = html.find(key)
    if i >= 0:
        start = i + len(key)
        end = html.find('"', start)
        if end > start - 1 and html[start:end] != doc.name:
            html = html[:start] + doc.name + html[end:]
            doc.html = html

    # 2. collect "slot:" comment lines, in order
    found = []
    seen = []
    for part in html.split("{#")[1:]:
        body = part.split("#}")[0].strip().strip("-").strip()
        if body.lower().startswith("slot:"):
            spec = body[5:]
            label = spec.split("|")[0].strip()
            hint = spec.split("|", 1)[1].strip() if "|" in spec else ""
            if label and label not in seen:
                seen.append(label)
                found.append([label, hint])

    # 3. sync the Image Slots table (only for formats that use slot lines)
    if found:
        existing = {}
        for r in doc.get("custom_image_slots") or []:
            existing[r.label] = r
        rows = []
        for f in found:
            old = existing.get(f[0])
            if old:
                rows.append({
                    "label": f[0],
                    "hint": f[1] or old.hint,
                    "default_image": old.default_image,
                    "quotation_field": old.quotation_field,
                })
            else:
                rows.append({"label": f[0], "hint": f[1]})
        doc.set("custom_image_slots", rows)

Solar Settings - Package Sections
script:
# Solar Settings > Solar Package tab.
# Keeps one Section Break + one item Table on Solar Package Template for every section listed.
# A removed or switched-off section is only HIDDEN, never deleted, so items already saved in it are kept.
cint = frappe.utils.cint
DT = "Solar Package Template"


def make_slug(s):
    out = ""
    for ch in (s or "").lower():
        if ch.isalnum() and ch.isascii():
            out = out + ch
        elif out and out[-1] != "_":
            out = out + "_"
    return out.strip("_")[:40]


def ensure_field(dt, df):
    name = dt + "-" + df["fieldname"]
    if frappe.db.exists("Custom Field", name):
        cf = frappe.get_doc("Custom Field", name)
        changed = False
        for k in df:
            cur = cf.get(k)
            if str(cur if cur is not None else "") != str(df[k] if df[k] is not None else ""):
                cf.set(k, df[k])
                changed = True
        if changed:
            cf.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    else:
        d = {"doctype": "Custom Field", "dt": dt}
        d.update(df)
        frappe.get_doc(d).insert(ignore_permissions=True)


on = cint(doc.get("custom_package_sections_enabled"))
rows = doc.get("custom_package_sections") or []

if not (doc.get("custom_main_section_title") or "").strip():
    doc.custom_main_section_title = "Main Package Items"

# give every section a permanent field name (kept even if the section is renamed later)
used = []
for r in rows:
    r.section_name = (r.section_name or "").strip()
    if not r.section_name:
        frappe.throw("Solar Package section row " + str(r.idx) + ": enter a Section Name")
    if r.field_key:
        used.append(r.field_key)
for r in rows:
    if not r.field_key:
        base = "custom_sec_" + (make_slug(r.section_name) or "section")
        k = base
        i = 2
        while k in used:
            k = base + "_" + str(i)
            i = i + 1
        r.field_key = k
        used.append(k)

# sections, in the order of the table, after the package totals
after = "net_package_amount"
keep = []
for r in rows:
    hid = 0 if (on and cint(r.enabled)) else 1
    brk = r.field_key.replace("custom_sec_", "custom_secb_", 1)
    ensure_field(DT, {"fieldname": brk, "fieldtype": "Section Break", "label": r.section_name, "insert_after": after, "hidden": hid})
    ensure_field(DT, {"fieldname": r.field_key, "fieldtype": "Table", "options": "Solar Package Template Item", "label": r.section_name, "insert_after": brk, "hidden": hid})
    keep.append(brk)
    keep.append(r.field_key)
    after = r.field_key

# sections removed from the list: hide them (data stays)
for cf in frappe.get_all("Custom Field", filters={"dt": DT, "fieldname": ["like", "custom_sec%"]}, fields=["name", "fieldname", "hidden"]):
    fn = cf.fieldname or ""
    if (fn.startswith("custom_sec_") or fn.startswith("custom_secb_")) and fn not in keep and not cint(cf.hidden):
        c = frappe.get_doc("Custom Field", cf.name)
        c.hidden = 1
        c.save(ignore_permissions=True)

# summary chips at the top of the package form
ensure_field(DT, {"fieldname": "custom_package_summary", "fieldtype": "HTML", "label": "Package Summary", "insert_after": "is_active", "hidden": 0 if on else 1})

# Returns the Customer Work Stage order from Solar Settings > Work Stages.
# Readable by every logged-in user (Solar Settings itself is System Manager only).
# An empty list means: use the stages built into the dashboard.
cint = frappe.utils.cint
S = "Solar Settings"
rows = []
if frappe.db.exists("DocType", "Solar Work Stage"):
    rows = frappe.get_all(
        "Solar Work Stage",
        filters={"parent": S, "parenttype": S, "parentfield": "custom_work_stages"},
        fields=["show", "title", "document", "icon", "optional", "status_field", "done_values", "customer_field", "key"],
        order_by="idx asc",
    )
out = []
for r in rows:
    out.append({
        "show": cint(r.show),
        "key": r.key,
        "title": r.title,
        "doctype": r.document,
        "icon": r.icon or "",
        "optional": cint(r.optional),
        "status_field": r.status_field or "",
        "done_statuses": [x.strip() for x in (r.done_values or "").split(",") if x.strip()],
        "customer_field": r.customer_field or "customer",
    })
frappe.response["message"] = out
